name: Footslide correction by stride matching
body: A walk or run clip plays at the rate it was authored for, so feet slide when the character moves at another speed. Give each blend clip the ground speed its feet travel at, and scale the state's playback rate by actual speed over that ground speed (clamped).
plan: 1. AddBlendClip gains an optional ground speed (SetBlendGroundSpeed from Nyx). 2. The animator scales a blend state's rate by speed parameter over the blended ground speed, clamped 0.6 to 1.6, and only above 0.2 m/s. 3. Mannequin clips report their ground speeds. 4. Test: rate follows speed.
acceptance_criteria: Playback rate rises and falls with speed above and below the clip's ground speed
Idle and still characters are not sped up
definition_of_done: Tests added and `mist run test` passes
